symptom: VPN connection times out after authentication
appliesWhen: Sign-in or MFA succeeded, but the VPN timed out while connecting.
steps: Check whether a public website loads.
Retry once using the same VPN profile.
If it still times out, record the client error and when it occurred.
source: Simulated data - Internal IT Support - VPN-001

symptom: Internal website is unreachable while the VPN is connected
appliesWhen: The VPN client shows Connected, but a corporate intranet page fails to load.
steps: Note which sites are affected and record the browser error.
source: Simulated data - Internal IT Support - VPN-002

symptom: VPN sign-in does not trigger an MFA prompt
appliesWhen: The user expected an MFA push notification during VPN sign-in, but received none.
steps: Open the authenticator app and check for a pending request.
Retry sign-in once and record what happens.
source: Simulated data - Internal IT Support - VPN-003

appliesWhen: The VPN client reaches Connected, then the VPN connection itself drops repeatedly.
steps: Record when the VPN disconnects and any error shown by the client.
Check whether the internet connection drops at the same time.
If the VPN keeps disconnecting, include the recorded details in an IT ticket.
source: Simulated data - Internal IT Support - VPN-004
